text: The system must allow a student to register using an email address and a password.
The system must allow a student to authenticate using an email address and a password.
The system must allow an instructor to upload a video file for a lecture.
The system must convert an uploaded video file into the playback format.
The system must allow a student to search for lectures.
The system must allow a student to view the details of a selected lecture.
The system must allow a student to pay for a lecture through an external payment provider.
The system must enrol a student in a lecture after successful payment.
The system must store a student's playback position for a lecture.
The system must resume playback from the stored position on a subsequent visit.
The system must allow an instructor to view the number of students enrolled in each of their lectures.
The system must allow an instructor to view the revenue generated by each of their lectures.
The system must allow an administrator to remove an inappropriate lecture from public view.
The system must provide a lecture listing service.
The system must store student personal data.
The lecture listing response must be returned within 2 seconds of request receipt.
The system must handle traffic up to ten times the normal load during the first week of a semester.
Card details must not be stored by the system.
The system must process payment card information only through the external payment provider.
Student personal data must be stored only within the country.
New features must be released without taking the service down.
If video conversion fails, the rest of the service must continue operating for students.
